metadata.description: Simple Drawing Pad: sketch an idea by hand with a graphics tablet, mouse or touch screen and let Claude look at it.

plugins.name: simple-drawing-pad
plugins.description: Sketch an idea by hand and paste it to Claude or any app. On Windows it needs a small helper program on your computer: built from the included source (nothing downloaded, no admin rights), it starts with Windows, works only locally (no network, collects nothing) and keeps your last 10 drawings; /simple-drawing-pad:uninstall removes it. The plugin asks once per computer before installing it. Then Ctrl+Alt+D opens the drawing window, Enter copies, Ctrl+V pastes. Simple as that.
